title: Mounted Walk stomp emits configured feedback once

verification.actor: MOUNTED species 155 (cyndaquil), acquired through mount; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Mount the current Cyndaquil follower; Complete one Walk at the configured stomp threshold; Complete one control Walk below the stomp threshold
verification.observable: Two ordinary mounted Walks each commit once and return control with paired native poses. At threshold 2, the 2-frame Walk emits one stomp event, creates skid dust and starts the stock ledge-hop landing sound 1606. The 3-frame Walk emits none of these. Missing native reader coverage is a failure, not zero feedback.

setupMutations.change: Private test.sav, checked teleport to map33 tile588/406, party slot0 Cyndaquil155 and its own mounted follower. Set idle Owner time2, threshold2 and zero acceleration.
After the first completed move and control release, set only the idle lane travel time to3 with the same threshold2. Normal rider input drives both moves.

limits: Controlled fixture evidence does not establish unchanged authored-profile timing.
Native sound-start success is not proof of audible output from speakers. Separate current reader-control acceptance is required.

events.value: Complete one Walk at the configured stomp threshold
Complete one control Walk below the stomp threshold

stop.condition: The positive and negative Walk cases finish and control returns

invariants: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result
No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation
